sections.title: Life Skills — Anatomy and reproduction
sections.passage: Ovaries contain egg cells; testes produce sperm cells after puberty begins. A pregnancy can begin when a sperm fertilizes an egg, usually in a fallopian tube, and the resulting developing structure implants in the uterus. Puberty does not mean someone is ready to become a parent. Private body parts have correct anatomical names, and questions deserve accurate respectful answers. Grade 7 extension: sexually transmitted infections can spread through sexual contact, sometimes without symptoms. Avoiding sexual contact prevents sexual transmission; correctly used condoms reduce but do not eliminate infection risk. Other birth-control methods do not protect against STIs. A trusted adult or health professional can answer questions.
